subject: Post-call: Cloud buying path & marketplace readiness (AWS) -- next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@medgen.ai>; Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medgen.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Cloud buying path & marketplace readiness (AWS) -- next steps

Thanks again for the time this morning — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement and the path to production:

Summary of discovery:
- Use case: Inference for clinical document search and patient summarization (batch + low-latency API for UI widgets).
- Priority: Proof-of-concept in June, production decision by end of Q3.
- Current infra: Core workloads in AWS; some teams evaluate GCP for analytics.

Procurement posture (what you clarified):
- Primary preference: AWS Marketplace for production purchases (security & consolidated billing).
- Short-term: card payment OK for a short PoC to start immediately.
- Procurement constraints: need PO for any contract > $25k and require vendor questionnaire + SOC2 evidence.

Asks / items for Redwood to action:
1) Ben: I attached the pricing sheet (Redwood_pricing_v3.pdf) and a short mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_medgen.xlsx). Can you confirm a PO-friendly version of the commercial terms and an AWS Marketplace SKU we can recommend?
2) Amelia/Jordan: Can you confirm the procurement contact (email for PO routing) and an estimated approval window for a PO if we move to production? You mentioned a 30–60 day cycle — is that accurate?
3) Procurement evidence: I attached our SOC2 summary page in the Drive link; if you want formal artifacts we can provision a secure upload.

Proposed next steps:
- Immediate: Start a 2-week PoC on card to validate latency/throughput (we can invoice on card).
- Parallel: Redwood prepares Marketplace onboarding checklist and PO-ready commercial terms.
- Schedule: 30-minute procurement intro call w/ your procurement contact + Ben (pricing/marketplace) — suggest Thu 11am PT or Fri 9am PT.

If those items look right, I’ll schedule the call and loop in our marketplace enablement contact. Appreciate a quick confirmation on procurement email and preferred cadence.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
kmpark@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_v3.pdf, mutual_action_plan_medgen.xlsx

From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@medgen.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medgen.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@medgen.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cloud buying path & marketplace readiness (AWS) -- next steps

Thanks Kim — this is very helpful and accurate. A few clarifications from procurement side:

- Marketplace preference: Correct, we prefer to buy through AWS Marketplace for final production because it goes on our consolidated bill and simplifies vendor risk when the listing exists.
- PO threshold: Any commit expected to exceed $25k needs a PO (and purchase order number) and our legal needs to sign vendor terms if the spend is annualized.
- Timeline: For a PO and contract review expect ~4–6 weeks once the vendor terms are agreed. For a simple PO under an approved SOW, 2–3 weeks is possible.

Procurement contact: procurement@medgen.ai (cc’d). Our internal procurement lead is Jordan Lee (cc’d).

Marketplace note: We don’t currently have a vendor relationship with Redwood on AWS Marketplace. If you can provide a short checklist for Marketplace onboarding and the SKU you anticipate, that will speed review.

Attachments: procurement_requirements_medgen.docx — I included our standard vendor info template (basic fields + required SOC2 link).

We are open to running the PoC on card to start; that will help demonstrate value while Marketplace/onboarding runs in parallel.

—Amelia
VP, Product Operations
MedGen Therapeutics
amelia.torres@medgen.ai

Appreciate the clarity, Amelia — good call on parallel tracks. A few quick notes and actions from our side: 

- Ben will propose two commercial paths: (A) PoC on card (month-by-month) and (B) Production via AWS Marketplace or PO with a term SOW. Ben — can you prepare a PO-friendly SOW template + a suggested SKU/price band for Marketplace?
- Marketplace onboarding: we'll send our internal checklist and the expected timeline (typically 4–8 weeks for listing + verification). Link to our enablement checklist included below.
- Scheduling: Jordan / procurement team — does Thu 3 Jun 11am PT work for a 30-min intro? If not, propose alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Proposed kickoff for PoC: start next week if you approve the card route; we’ll spin up a dedicated sandbox on your AWS account and provide a short runbook (latency/traffic targets, observability).

I’ll attach the PO-friendly SOW and a redlined pricing note; Ben, please add the HubSpot deal id to the docs when ready (we’ll need that for the marketplace listing).

Best,
Kim
